_authoritative_layer_note: The deterministic authority is the PreToolUse guard (.claude/hooks/guard.mjs). This permissions.deny list is a best-effort defense-in-depth MIRROR — simple glob permissions cannot express package-runner unwrapping (npx/pnpm dlx), PowerShell -EncodedCommand, Start-Process, or dynamic iex. Do not treat the deny-list as complete; the guard is the layer that covers those.
_execution_boundary_note: O2-S1R-R02 (OWNER DECISION REQUIRED before unattended L2 activation): the guard classifies COMMAND STRINGS. It cannot see inside an executed program, so `node script.js` / `powershell -File x.ps1` / `./x.sh` / `npm run <script>` can internally invoke `git push` via Git Credential Manager. Command classification alone therefore cannot guarantee the all-branch no-autonomous-push invariant. Closure requires a CAPABILITY boundary (credential-free / isolated execution), not more parsing — see docs analysis. Until the owner selects an execution-boundary model, the guard + human gates are necessary but NOT sufficient for unattended arbitrary-script autonomy.
